sources.snippet: GLM-4.1V-9B-Base is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find GLM-4.1V-9B-Base on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of GLM-4.1V-9B-Base install, users can directly use GLM-4.1V-9B-Base installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
